events.verdict: Holiday (BOS) makes clean contact with the ball to dislodge it from Maxey's (PHI) possession and the ensuing contact is incidental.
The ball goes off of Porzingis's (BOS) foot and out of bounds.
Brown (BOS) and Oubre Jr. (PHI) briefly engage and disengage during the throw-in.
Brown (BOS) makes contact to Oubre Jr.'s (PHI) arm as he starts his upward shooting motion, affecting the jump shot attempt.
Oubre Jr. (PHI) reaches in multiple times, but the contact with White (BOS) near midcourt is marginal.
Tatum (BOS) places his off-arm against Maxey (PHI) and releases from contact.
Porzingis (BOS) is drawn into the air on the pump fake and initiates body contact to Council IV (PHI) that affects his shot attempt.
Yabusele (PHI) legally contests Holiday's (BOS) jump shot attempt.

Replay review of the foul called on Holiday (BOS) pursuant to a coach's challenge was deemed successful. Holiday maintains a legal guarding position during Maxey's (PHI) drive to the basket and avoids making any illegal contact.
Oubre Jr. (PHI) legally contests Holiday's (BOS) jump shot attempt.
Maxey (PHI) places his forearm against Porzingis's (BOS) body during his shot attempt and the contact is marginal.
Porzingis (BOS) cleanly blocks Edwards' (PHI) jump shot attempt.
